goal: Establish the Campaign access boundary: requireCampaignAdmin for Admin/Preacher/Assistant, requireDialerCaller for any active caller, campaignScope with per-role scope and assignable caller set, the denial-sweep harness, the static route-coverage guardrail, and the Assistant e2e role.
outcome: Every /api/dialer/** route has a denial-sweep row; unauthenticated is refused; a non-owning caller gets 404 with no payload; the owning caller succeeds; campaignScope returns program for Admin, preacher userId for Preacher, their preacher's userId for Assistant, and refuses a Preacher/Assistant with no scope id; the assignable caller set matches AD-3; scripts/verify-dialer-route-coverage.mjs fails pnpm guardrails when a route has no sweep row; Assistant role is wired in the e2e harness and package.json has test:e2e:campaign.

requirements.statement: Story 1.2 in epics.md; AD-2, AD-3, AD-7, AD-8, AD-14.

The API split is structural: /api/dialer/admin/** calls requireCampaignAdmin then campaignScope; /api/dialer/caller/** calls requireDialerCaller then assertCallerAssignmentInScope. Never one guard for both populations.
The caller path returns 404 for both missing and foreign assignments. The admin surface may keep 403 vs 404.
campaignScope has no fallback — a Preacher or Assistant with no scope id is 403, never program scope.
Determinism is deliberately deferred to Epic 4 even though this story edits the role fixture and playwright.config.ts. Story 1.3's full run exercises the changed harness.
pnpm test:e2e:list campaign- confirms the filter wiring.
